_noteWPassive: W PASSIVE CURATED (loop 499). The old note called this blocked on an unmapped mStat 15 and an ambiguous shield calc. Both were red herrings: mStat 15 only appears in the hashed wrapper {79b6144b}, which multiplies the fraction by the targets missing health - something the engine already does itself for a hit with hpBasis Missing. The fraction ALONE, MissingHealthPercent, resolves fine (0.12 at 300 AP, matching the wikis 3% + 3% per 100 AP). Live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ekko, fetched 2026-08-21): Ekkos basic attacks against enemies BELOW 30% maximum health deal bonus magic damage equal to 3% (+3% per 100 AP) of their MISSING health. Curated as an alwaysOn on-hit rider - it is Ws passive and needs no cast - carrying the threshold as HpBelow 0.3 through metHpPercentCalc, the field added in loop 479 for exactly this shape. Default unmet, so a plain auto against a healthy target is unchanged. The 15 minimum and 150 cap against minions and monsters are out of scope for a champion-target calculator. The W ACTIVE still deals no damage - that part of the old note was right.

W.note: Parallel Convergence ACTIVE = shield + stun, NO direct damage (user-confirmed): the rank-scaled 80->200 array is 'TotalShield' (a defensive stat), and W's active cast deals nothing. W's built-in low-HP on-hit PASSIVE (BaseOnHitDamage 3 + 0.03AP scaled by the target's missing-HP%, applying only vs targets at/below the health threshold) is intentionally NOT curated here: mStat=15 (target missing-HP%) is unmapped in BuildStatResolver and the on-hit threshold-gate is unsupported -- deferred rather than fabricated.
